comparison.objective: PR-1961 fills and strikes three drywall holes flush; the candidate adjusts and locks robot-gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1961 tests loading, packing, and angle-controlled wiping with a putty knife, unlike coaxial driver seating and wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1961 measures filled-hole depth, proud material, surface damage, and knife set-down; the candidate measures retained opening angle, locking, and repeat cycles.
comparison.reason: Material deposition and surface finishing are unrelated to coupled threaded adjustment and functional retention.
